_doc: News shown in game (newest first). id changes trigger the popup once.

news.title: 每日／每週裂隙同活動系統上線
news.titleEn: Daily / weekly rifts and events are live
news.body: 喺傳送門揀「每日裂隙」或「每週裂隙」：全世界同一個種子同詞綴，第一次通關送金幣同傳奇，每日連續通關獎勵越嚟越多。開張慶典期間所有獎勵 +25%。
news.bodyEn: Pick Daily or Weekly Rift at the portal: same seed and modifiers for everyone; the first clear pays gold and a legendary, and daily streaks pay more. All rewards +25% during the celebration.
